targetText: The development of society has been a very rapid one in all civilized states of the world during recent decades, and any new achievement in any realm of human activity still hastens this development.
summary: Shifting to the broader critique of the capitalist state, Bebel exposes how growing wealth polarization, militarism, public debt, and indirect taxation burden the proletariat, proving that parliamentary patchwork reforms cannot cure the structural contradictions of class society.
